newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican farmers withdraw from blocking oil field.
newsitem.headline: Mexican farmers withdraw from blocking oil field.

text.p: Indigenous farmers that obstructed access to an oil field Monday have left the Tabasco state field, a spokeswoman for state-owned Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said Tuesday.

She said the Sen field in the Nacajuca district was blocked Monday by farmers, who left the area after meeting with Pemex officials and discussing the company's 1997 projects to develop infrastructure in indigenous zones in the area.
In 1994 the field produced 34,000 barrels of crude per day and 81 million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
In February Pemex said it lost $13 million when leftist party members blocked access to 60 Tabasco oil wells for three weeks.
